scenes.stage_direction: The search becomes a confrontation with named decision-makers. Each signed record changes a concrete next step.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The office used delegated authority beyond what the person had agreed.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Another borrowed name. How many doors can a borrowed name hold shut?

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The person has agreed to intervene in their own name.

metadata.evidence_summary: An office used another person's name to delay action.
